Step 3. By the parabolic spectral theorem, we decompose \(S_{01320013} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the parabolic spectral family.

Conclusion. By Steps 1-3, applying the exponential convergence theorem, we conclude the proof with \(C = C_01320011 \cdot C_01320012 \cdot C_01320013\).
